label: Enable remote analysis
help: Off by default. Sends the prepared image, task and schema to OpenAI; API usage is billed. No network call during preparation.

label: OpenAI wallet reference
help: Complete reference, for example secret://workspace/openai_vision_api. Never enter the key itself.

label: Permitted image directory
help: Only local files below this directory. Empty uses the application root. URLs and symbolic links are refused.

label: Default analysis task
help: A precise inspection question. The task input overrides it for subsequent image events; image JSON can carry its own task atomically.

label: Result JSON schema
help: Strict object schema: all properties required, additionalProperties:false. Use nullable fields for unknown values. No references or patterns.

label: OpenAI model
help: Pinned image-capable model. Account access is checked only when you send an image.

label: Image detail
help: Auto balances detail; low/high are explicit provider options. Dimensions are bounded separately.

label: Maximum submitted side (px)
help: Preserve aspect ratio and reduce large images. EXIF orientation is applied; metadata is removed.

label: Maximum source pixels
help: Reject excessive decoded images before conversion; no silent crop.

label: Maximum input bytes
help: Bound the source file before decoding; default 10 MiB.

label: Analysis deadline (seconds)
help: Stop cancels local processing and closes the request. An already submitted request may still be billed. No automatic retry.

label: Maximum output tokens
help: Incomplete or invalid JSON produces issues only, never a partial result.
